payload.message: Wembley Central: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound Southern / London Northwestern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Fulham Broadway: No Step Free Access- Step free access is not available to the westbound platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Harold Wood Station: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to platform 3 (towards Liverpool Street) due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Liverpool Street Station: No Step Free Access - No step free access between the National Rail concourse and the eastbound Circle, Hamm & City and Metropolitan lines due to a faulty lift. Use the Elizabeth line entrance on Broadgate for step free access.

Harrow & Wealdstone: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound London Northwestern / Southern (platforms 4 and 5) due to a faulty lift. Call 0343 222 1234 for help planning your journey.
